description: Build a cluster-resident single-queue pipeline for batch60/n1024: fuse workspace gather, 256-wide factorization, panel solve, and rank-k scheduling; TMA-multicast diagonal and panel tiles, distribute trailing updates across persistent clusters, publish dependency epochs, and emit final lower factors directly instead of repeated sidecar and staging passes.

Removed the full batch60/n1024 lower staging copy: stage 0 now gathers the diagonal and initializes panel solves and triangular rank-k directly from input, while later stages consume cumulative output Schur complements. Full validation and all 15 benchmark cells passed; batch60/n1024 measured 878.321 us and global geomean 731.209 us.

Fused the per-stage 256x256 diagonal gather into the two-CTA factor kernel. Each factor wave now reads and transposes the full source lower tile directly into shared memory, removing the standalone 2160-CTA gather launch. Full validation and all benchmark cells passed; batch60/n1024 measured 875.443 us and global geomean 730.659 us.

Expanded the factor pipeline from two to three CTAs per matrix (180 CTAs), assigned one first-panel tile per worker, and replaced the binary arrival flag with a counted epoch barrier. Correctness and all cells passed, but cross-CTA wait/scheduling overhead raised batch60/n1024 to 1173.355 us and global geomean to 746.602 us.

Replaced spin-wait factor residency with an explicit current-queue inner tile DAG: a 26 KiB diagonal POTRF/update kernel followed by independent 3/2/1 panel CTAs per matrix, removing device polling and long-lived factor register state. All cells passed. batch60/n1024 improved to 847.370 us versus 875.443 us on trial 1, while noisy unaffected cells yielded global geomean 746.589 us.

Replaced the live batch60/n1024 path with a full 16x16 left-looking 64-tile DAG. Each diagonal/panel task accumulates all prior FP16-factor/FP32-accumulate updates from the original input and emits lower factors directly, eliminating live 256-wide rank-k/copy staging. All cells passed, but repeated sidecar reloads and 31 DAG nodes measured batch60/n1024 at 1305.203 us and global geomean 779.294 us.

Converted the full 64-tile path to right-looking factor/panel/update epochs, but the first remote validation attempt remained queued in Modal for 944.575 s without starting eval output and was terminated as an infrastructure timeout. Local build passed; no metric was produced. Retrying the unchanged committed candidate.

Retried unchanged right-looking 64-tile factor/panel/update epochs after the Modal infrastructure timeout. Full validation and all benchmark cells passed. Materializing every triangular 64x64 Schur tile exposed 40,800 update CTAs per replay and measured batch60/n1024 at 3012.212 us, global geomean 810.135 us.

Measured the whole-operation optimized-library control by dispatching batch60/n1024 directly to torch.linalg.cholesky_ex/cuSOLVER. Full validation and all cells passed. cuSOLVER measured 2896.591 us on batch60/n1024 and 791.516 us global, confirming that the custom ff7b7ea pipeline is 3.31x faster on this target.

Measured the extension's direct cusolverDnSpotrfBatched path with a cached output, pointer table, info tensor, and BF16x9 FP32-emulation math mode. Full validation and all cells passed. It improved over generic torch.linalg but still measured batch60/n1024 at 2592.938 us and global geomean 797.699 us.

Measured the cached 256-wide library pipeline: cusolverDnSpotrfBatched panels, cublasStrsmBatched solves, and strided tensor-core trailing GEMMs. Full validation and all cells passed. batch60/n1024 measured 2299.733 us and global geomean 778.116 us, faster than whole-matrix cuSOLVER but 2.63x slower than ff7b7ea.

Restored the explicit 256-factor tile DAG as the live batch60/n1024 path after library controls. Full validation and all cells passed. The confirmation improved batch60/n1024 to 836.782 us (from 847.370) and produced a new run-wide global geomean leader of 723.820 us.

Fused every 64-wide inner factor/panel store directly into the final lower output and removed all four outer prepare/copy passes. Standard validation passed, but the batch60 benchmark checker found relative upper-triangle residue 0.221 because the CuTe triangular rank-k writes the physical upper region; the prior final copy had also served as the upper-zeroing pass. No metric produced.

Kept direct factor/panel emission for all 64-wide tiles, removed the first three intermediate prepare launches, and restored only the final factor copy/upper-zeroing pass. Full validation and all cells passed. The added per-tile transposed stores outweighed three removed prepares: batch60/n1024 measured 871.525 us and noisy global geomean 755.822 us.

Removed direct factor-kernel output stores, retained the first three removed prepare/copy launches, and fused the ten 64x64 factor-tile copies into existing outer panel-solve CTAs while keeping the final copy/upper-zeroing pass. Build and full standard validation passed, but the complete benchmark failed at batch60/n1024 because output contained NaN or Inf; no metric was produced.

Graceful shutdown complete at restoration commit 1eb2a6ffc0f9aa1c8ead2b61ae8dc14a5d79ac7e, whose submission.py exactly matches validated commit 5578d436b2fcac82c4f99370f0976c71e5922444. Best measured global geomean was 723.820 us with batch60/n1024 at 836.782 us. Later direct-emission variants measured 755.822 us or failed correctness; final fused-copy trial c2c63d8 passed build and standard validation but benchmark batch60/n1024 produced NaN/Inf. Unexplored variants include epoch-guarded panel-copy fusion and direct lower emission paired with isolated upper zeroing. Local profiling is waived by layout; dashboard untouched.
